name: bricscad-mcp
description: Read, audit and edit drawings in BricsCAD through a LISP listener.
long_description:
Starts its own BricsCAD window and controls it through a small LISP listener, so it works at every licence level, including Lite, and doesn't need Windows COM. Reads and audits drawings, draws and edits entities, and runs LISP for anything else.

Self-contained: the bundle carries its own Python and every dependency, so there is nothing to install first. BricsCAD must be installed.

**Updating:** install the newest `.mcpb` for your platform from the [releases page](https://github.com/alesdev88/bricscad-mcp/releases) over this one.

template.note: Template. scripts/build_bundle.py rewrites the server block and platforms for each bundle it builds; this shows the macOS shape.

tools.name: bricscad_audit_report
tools.description: Report empty layers, unused blocks, missing xrefs, entities not at zero elevation, and off-standard layer names.

tools.name: bricscad_list_versions
tools.description: List the BricsCAD versions installed on this computer, newest first.

tools.name: bricscad_start
tools.description: Start BricsCAD in its own window and connect to it. Refuses if that version is already running.

tools.name: bricscad_stop
tools.description: Close the BricsCAD this server started. Refuses if drawings have unsaved changes.

tools.name: bricscad_status
tools.description: Report whether BricsCAD is running, how recently its listener reported, and the current drawing.

tools.name: bricscad_run_lisp
tools.description: Run LISP in BricsCAD and return the value of its last expression.

tools.name: bricscad_open_drawing
tools.description: Open a DWG or DXF and make it the current drawing. Returns the same details as bricscad_drawing_info.

tools.name: bricscad_close_drawing
tools.description: Close the current drawing. Refuses if it has unsaved changes.

tools.name: bricscad_drawing_info
tools.description: Describe the current drawing: name, path, read-only and modified state, units, limits, entity count and layouts.

tools.name: bricscad_list_layers
tools.description: List layers with their on, frozen and locked state, color, linetype and entity count. Up to 2000 per call.

tools.name: bricscad_list_blocks
tools.description: List block definitions with insert counts, including nested inserts and inserts of dynamic blocks. Up to 2000 per call.

tools.name: bricscad_list_xrefs
tools.description: List external references with their stored path and whether the file was found. Up to 2000 per call.

tools.name: bricscad_list_layouts
tools.description: List Model and the paper space layouts with their entity counts. Up to 2000 per call.

tools.name: bricscad_query_entities
tools.description: Find entities in the current drawing. Returns handle, type, layer, layout and bounding box. Up to 2000 per call.

tools.name: bricscad_get_entity
tools.description: Return one entity's type, layer and all its DXF group codes, as [code, value] pairs.

tools.name: bricscad_read_attributes
tools.description: Read attribute values from block inserts, for example title block contents. Up to 2000 per call.

tools.name: bricscad_find_text
tools.description: Search TEXT, MTEXT, MULTILEADER, table cell and block attribute text for literal text.

tools.name: bricscad_undo
tools.description: Undo the last edits to the current drawing. Returns how many steps were undone.

tools.name: bricscad_erase_entities
tools.description: Erase entities by handle. Erases all of them or none. bricscad_undo restores them.

tools.name: bricscad_set_layer
tools.description: Create a layer, or change one that exists. Only the values you give are changed.

tools.name: bricscad_modify_entities
tools.description: Change entities by handle. Changes all of them or none, and refuses locked layers.

tools.name: bricscad_set_attributes
tools.description: Set attribute values on block inserts, such as a title block. Changes all of them or none.

tools.name: bricscad_create_entities
tools.description: Draw entities and return their handles. Draws all of them or none, as one undo step.

tools.name: bricscad_save_drawing
tools.description: Save the current drawing. Returns the same details as bricscad_drawing_info.

tools.name: bricscad_export_dxf
tools.description: Write the current drawing as a DXF file. The drawing keeps its name and state.

tools.name: bricscad_plot_pdf
tools.description: Plot one layout of the current drawing to a PDF file, with Print As PDF.pc3. The drawing is not changed.

tools.name: bricscad_preview_image
tools.description: Return a PNG of the current drawing, to check work by eye. The drawing is not changed.

tools.name: bricscad_batch_run
tools.description: Run one job on many drawings, one at a time, and report a result per file. Try dry_run first.

bricscad_version.title: BricsCAD version
bricscad_version.description: The version to start, for example 26. Leave blank for the newest installed.

bricscad_executable.title: BricsCAD program
bricscad_executable.description: Only if BricsCAD isn't found automatically: the full path to the BricsCAD program.
